resolved.title: 输入
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The "[b]fmt[/b]" package also allows you to take input from the user of the program.
To take input, we need to use the [b]Scanln()[/b] function and provide it with the variable which should hold the input value:
[code format="go" codeId="3310"]var input string
[b]fmt.Scanln(&input)[/b]

fmt.Println(input) [/code]
Now the [b]input[/b] variable will hold the value which the user enters when running the program.

[note]Note the [b]ampersand &[/b] before the variable name -- it is used to return the address of a variable. We will learn more about it in a later lesson.[/note]

content.text:
**fmt**不仅可以输出内容，还允许程序从用户那里获取输入。
为了接受输入，需要使用`Scanln()`函数，且需要提供保存输入值的变量：
content.text_html:
The "fmt" package also allows you to take input from the user of the program. To take input, we need to use the Scanln() function and provide it with the variable which should hold the input value:

"fmt"包还允许你从程序的用户那里获取输入。 为了接受输入，我们需要使用**Scanln()**函数，并向它提供应保存输入值的变量。

content.short_content:
var input string
// 将输入保存到变量input
fmt.Scanln(&input)

fmt.Println(input)

content.text: 现在，**input**变量将保存用户在运行程序时输入的值，其实就是文本，因为`input`变量是`string`类型。
content.text_html:
Now the input variable will hold the value which the user enters when running the program.

现在，input变量将保存用户在运行程序时输入的数值。

content.text: 注意变量名称前的`&` -- 它是用来返回变量的地址。我们将在后面的课程中进一步学习它。
content.text_html:
Note the ampersand & before the variable name -- it is used to return the address of a variable. We will learn more about it in a later lesson.

注意变量名称前的ampersand & -- 它是用来返回变量的地址。我们将在后面的课程中进一步了解它。

resolved.title: 输入
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The previous example took the input from the user as a [b]string[/b].
If we need to take a number as input, such as an integer, we can simply declare the type of the [b]input[/b] variable as [b]int[/b] and Go will automatically convert the input to that type:[code format="go" codeId="3311"]var input [b]int[/b]
fmt.Scanln(&input)

fmt.Println(input*2) [/code]
[note]You can call the [b]Scanln[/b]() function multiple times in order to take multiple inputs from the user during the program.[/note]

fmt.Scanln(&input)

content.text:
前面的例子将用户的输入作为**字符串**。
如果我们需输入一个数字，比如一个整数，可以简单地将**input**变量的类型声明为**int**，Go会自动将输入值转为该类型：
content.text_html:
The previous example took the input from the user as a string. If we need to take a number as input, such as an integer, we can simply declare the type of the input variable as int and Go will automatically convert the input to that type:

前面的例子将用户的输入作为字符串。 如果我们需要取一个数字作为输入，比如一个整数，我们可以简单地将input变量的类型声明为int，Go会自动将输入转换为该类型。

content.short_content:
// input 为int 类型
var input int
fmt.Scanln(&input)

fmt.Println(input*2)

content.text: 你也可以多次调用**Scanln**()函数，这样用户就可以多次输入。
content.text_html:
You can call the Scanln() function multiple times in order to take multiple inputs from the user during the program.

你可以多次调用Scanln()函数，以便在程序中接受用户的多次输入。

resolved.title: 英尺转英寸
resolved.problem_statement_md:
编写程序，将英尺转换为英寸并输出结果。
用户输入英尺数值。

**公式**：1英尺= **12**英寸
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Feet to Inches Converter[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to create a program that converts feet to inches and outputs the resulting value.
The feet value is provided as the input to the program.
1 foot = [b]12[/b] inches. 

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
5

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
60

[note]The input is an integer.[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
    var i int
    fmt.Scanln(&i)
    fmt.Println(i*12)
}
